result: zic and zdump in libc-bin: zic decodes identically to the reference for 593/598 zones fat and -L, 590/598 slim (the rest read the same); zdump -v/-i identical for all 497 installed zones over libniji's localtime
head: 0b7936dc5
informational: The coexist flavour ships no libc-bin utilities (getent, iconv, locale are system-only); zic and zdump follow that, so the brief's coexist part is not done.
Not run: Debian's tzdata package built in the swapped trixie root, and lintian (the deb build rebuilds release products; one product build per role). The manifest lint (deb_manifest) is in the gate.
zic -r is refused (exit 1); zic checks only literal abbreviation formats for its warnings; zdump rejects a malformed -c/-t even without a listing option.

Decoded differences left, listed in xtask/tests/tz_tools.rs with reasons and checked to read the same: Asia/Tbilisi, Europe/Lisbon, Europe/Warsaw (fat, -L, slim); America/Ciudad_Juarez, America/Ojinaga, America/Indiana/Winamac, Asia/Gaza, Asia/Hebron (slim only).

impact.what: libc-bin gains /usr/sbin/zic and /usr/bin/zdump (issue #14): tzdata can be compiled and zones checked on a libniji system
zic -b fat on tzdata 2026e tzdata.zi: zones decoding identically to the reference
zdump -v -c 1800,2100 over libniji localtime: zones printing identically to the reference
Yohane Linux tzdata rebuild (issue #14, zic/zdump part)

improvement: Each plant rebuilds all products (about 10-19 min here) although a csys/util program only needs its own compile and link; a utilities-only rebuild path in cargo xtask so would make utility plants minutes, not hours.
